class: Hold written into the drug name as the word held, which no word list contains. The structured order is an ordinary once-daily 5 mg dose.
Hold written as one joined token (OnHold), so the token check never sees on or hold as separate words.
Sliding scale written as one joined token (SlidingScale) in the drug name. The name rule blocks sliding and scale only as separate words.
Correction-scale insulin named with the word correction, which no word list contains. The structured order is a fixed 4 unit dose three times a day.
Sliding scale insulin named with the abbreviation SSI, which no word list contains. The structured order is a fixed 4 unit dose three times a day.
As-needed order named with the plural PRNs. The list blocks prn but not prns. The structured order has asNeededBoolean false and a once-daily timing.
Taper named with the inflected word tapered. The name rule blocks taper but not tapered. The structured order is a fixed 10 mg once-daily dose.
Weight-based dosing named with the words weight based, which no word list contains. The structured order is a fixed 1000 unit dose every 6 hours into a vein.
Weekly dosing named with weekday names, which the frequency list does not contain. The structured order is 15 mg once a day, so the name and the printed frequency disagree.
Every-other-day frequency written as the abbreviation EOD, which the frequency list does not contain. The structured order is 5 mg once a day.
Route written into the drug name (epidural). The structured route is by mouth, and the route word list does not contain epidural.
Control. The word hold is in the negation list, so the name rule should block it.
Control. The drug name contains sliding scale, which the name rule should block.
Control. The drug name contains taper, which the name rule should block.
